snippet.description:
In the race to become Texas’ next senator, Republican candidate Ken Paxton and his surrogates have leaned into a specific line of attack on Democrat James Talarcio. From calling him “low-T” to “Tofu Talarico” — they want this campaign to be a referendum on manliness. 

On the Today, Explained podcast, we head to Texas to ask: What does it mean to be a good man in politics?
